description: Capture and triage Pipeline ideas; run Ready items with a supervisor that starts one session per item and hands each to the specialist skills in the Horology Specialists plugin; plan items marked Plan; and write a daily digest.

defaultPrompt: Capture these ideas in the Welladino Pipeline and check for duplicates.
Run the Ready Pipeline items for this platform.
interface.longDescription: Horology skills for retaining ideas in Pipeline and for a supervisor that runs Ready items: it claims each in the Runs tab, starts one session per item locally or in the cloud, chooses the specialist skills, checks the results and records the run. Preserves duplicate checks and founder decision boundaries. Requires separately connected Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets; ClickUp access is needed when a task uses ClickUp. Install Horology Specialists for the specialist skills.
interface.shortDescription: Capture, run, plan and report on Pipeline items

name: welladino-workflows
